✦ About you

We ask so the system can match you with like minds — people like you, near you, into what you’re into. That’s the whole reason. Filling this out helps people find people like you — but that doesn’t mean they know who you are.

Type it in, or pick an example — make it your own. Click the eye for more information.

Your answers are for the match, not the world — only what you flip to public is ever seen.

✦ Cover buttons — your memberships

The buttons at the top corner of your cover, where visitors always see them — so they always see where to join. Smart marketing: your profile is a landing page. Each button has its own on/off — if you don’t want to promote a membership, turn it off. A button wakes up when you enter its URL — it takes the next empty spot, up to five. They are meant for memberships, but any URL works: a social site of yours can sit here too. Generic links belong in the Smart Bar.

✦Join NayaNET on the cover tooJoin NayaNET already sits in the hero row — turn this on to add it to the cover as an extra spot.Off
